name_vi: Băng ghế cung cong có tựa
description_en: A crescent bench with a curved woven seat and continuous low woven back on radial bamboo legs; the front shows the concave seating bay, the side reveals the back tilt, and the rear shows the convex back rail and fan-like braces under the seat. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: A crescent bench with a curved woven seat and continuous low woven back on radial bamboo legs; the front shows the concave seating bay, the side reveals the back tilt, and the rear shows the convex back rail and fan-like braces under the seat. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.. Style Zen: calm minimal ornament and simple proportions. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE ELEVATION: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, level with product center. Show its right profile; front-facing panel must be edge-on. Do not merely flip or mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
